title: Challengers (2024)
personalCommentary: If you love the intensity of Denis Villeneuve or David Fincher's kinetic editing, Guadagnino's tennis drama is pure sensory adrenaline set to Trent Reznor & Atticus Ross's pulsing electronic score.

title: Monster (Kaibutsu, 2023)
personalCommentary: A transcendent, deeply empathetic drama scored by Ryuichi Sakamoto. Like Drive My Car, it shifts your emotional equilibrium through profound structural patience.
